objective.statement: Keep the docs site free of broken external links by detecting and recording them nightly.
objective.per_run_success: link scan completed and every newly broken link is recorded in issues/broken-links.md, or a recorded no-op when nothing changed

authoritative_sources: docs/ directory of the project repository

freeze.manifest: not used: sources are read live each run

sensor.name: link-checker
sensor.signal: list of external URLs returning HTTP errors

comparator.rule: diff the current broken set against state.known_broken

decision_space: no-op when the diff is empty
stop and report when the scan tool fails

actuator.feedback_path: the next run's comparator reads the updated known_broken set

triggers.condition: daily at 03:00 local via host cron
triggers.preflight: skip when docs/ is unchanged since last run (git tree hash compare)

state.recovery: re-run the scan; entries are keyed by URL, so replays cannot duplicate records

roles.name: orchestrator
roles.responsibility: run the scan, compute the diff, route the result

roles.name: executor
roles.responsibility: write issue entries for newly broken links

roles.name: verifier
roles.responsibility: re-read reports/links.json and confirm every broken URL has an entry

capabilities.reason: single fixed script; this loop never needs to discover or create new capabilities

acceptance_checks: every URL in reports/links.json with status >= 400 appears in issues/broken-links.md
failure_path_checks: a non-zero exit from the scan tool stops the run without writing state

failure_policy.classification: network failure vs scan-tool failure vs content change
failure_policy.rollback: state is written last, so a failed run leaves the prior state intact
failure_policy.kill: remove the cron entry and delete loop/LOCK

runtime_safety.concurrency_lock: loop/LOCK file containing the holder pid

observability.status_view: loop/RUN-STATE.json plus the tail of loop/events/events.jsonl
alerts: two consecutive failed runs write loop/ALERT.md

replacement.atomic_promotion: contract edits land as one commit
replacement.inactive_history: git history, excluded from active retrieval

conditions: docs site retired or link checking moves into CI
retirement.history_visibility: inactive and excluded from normal retrieval
